reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: the January 31, 2026 independent accountant AUP (Johannes Juara & Rekan / Hari Manurung CPA) still reconciles Rp94,232,212,766 of bank collateral to total issued Rupiah Token with an explicit 1:1 ratio and states procedures obtained bank statements and time-deposit certificates for each collateral account. The live rupiahtoken.com site still describes IDRT as a rupiah-pegged token with mint/redeem against rupiah bank flows and states circulating IDRT is regularly audited by an independent auditor. The complete direct reserve class remains IDR bank deposits including time deposits; bank-level and account-type allocations are not published.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent accountant agreed-upon procedures over Rupiah Token bank collateral as of January 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No direct reserve category is unidentified. Bank identities, account balances, the time-deposit share, maturity terms, and legal custody safeguards are undisclosed.
